_README: Red-flag catalogue: 480 indicators in 30 categories, transcribed from the compliance red-flags document. Each entry is an alert for review, not an automatic conclusion. 'no' is the number from the source document and must not be renumbered. No severity, typology mapping or detection method is assigned; those are owner decisions. Separate from RED_FLAGS_HIGH in netlify/functions/brain-soul.js and not read by any engine yet.
